criteria.observation: Traces a concrete select/filter sequence and compares selected row and detail before and after it.
Identifies the owner and API consumers of visible selection and specifies a correction that keeps their observed states consistent.
Explains which implementation sites depend on the selection rule and shows a concrete outcome left wrong by a one-sided correction.
Distinguishes intentional history retention from a selection defect and avoids duplicate or unrelated findings.
Supports the merge decision with a repeatable contract-level check covering the returned state and view. A shared derivation or consistent state transition can satisfy it.
